mapper.select: SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.task_id,q.owner_actor_id,q.invocation_id,q.ordinal,q.record_version,q.question_version,q.revision,q.binding_digest,q.mode,q.effective_timeout,q.phase,q.request_snapshot,q.request_digest,q.created_at,q.foreground_due_at,q.answer_expires_at,q.retain_until,q.close_code,q.answer_id,q.answered_actor_id,q.answered_at,q.accepted_seq,q.answer_snapshot,q.answer_digest,q.answer_key,q.answer_request_digest,q.answer_source_revision,q.receipt_snapshot,q.delivery_state,q.delivery_step_id,q.retained_digests,i.provider_id FROM user_question q JOIN invocation i ON i.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND i.id=q.invocation_id WHERE q.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND q.task_id=#{task} ORDER BY q.ordinal
